notes: Original generated transparent PNG outputs retained without repainting. Runtime crops each frame by atlas grid; manifest records native image dimensions.

prompts.king:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: finished production transparent PNG sprite atlas for a 2D isometric game, not a concept presentation.
Primary request: 30 separate hand-painted animation frames of the SAME powerful silverback gorilla King wearing a small clearly visible golden laurel wreath. Dark cinematic stylized realistic detailed fur and expressive gorilla face, broad muscular shoulders, long arms, no clothing. Moonlit slate fur, warm gray face, clean silhouette.
Composition: one exactly aligned 6-column by 5-row rectangular grid, all cells equal 256x256, image 1536x1280. Transparent background, no text, no labels, no grid lines, no floor, no cast shadow. Each entire gorilla fits INSIDE its cell with 20 pixels clear margin, feet on a consistent baseline at 235 pixels. Same body scale every cell, art roughly 200px tall. Orthographic isometric view 30 degrees above ground.
Rows are consistent world facings: row 1 FRONT facing camera; row 2 FRONT-RIGHT three-quarter; row 3 RIGHT profile; row 4 BACK-RIGHT three-quarter; row 5 BACK facing away. The wreath remains properly on the head in ALL frames.
Columns in EACH row are six distinct animation key poses: column 1 relaxed idle standing on knuckles; column 2 walking LEFT arm and RIGHT leg forward; column 3 walking RIGHT arm and LEFT leg forward; column 4 attack anticipation, BOTH arms raised overhead; column 5 heavy smash followthrough with right arm thrust down and forward; column 6 recoil or crouched wounded recovery, body low and bent. Adjacent poses MUST visibly change articulated arms and legs, not just body position. All frames retain matching anatomy and proportions. Separate isolated transparent cutouts. High quality reusable actual game art.
prompts.apes:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent PNG animation atlas for an isometric survival strategy game.
Create a precisely arranged 6 columns × 6 rows sprite sheet, 1536x1536 pixels, equal 256px square cells, transparent empty background. Exactly one whole animal in each cell, never overlapping cells, no text, no grid, no scenery, no contact shadows. Each sprite fits in central 220x220 area with feet at y=235 within its cell. Orthographic view 30 degrees above ground. Rich hand-painted cinematic realistic animal anatomy, detailed fur, distinct faces, moonlit olive slate palette; rusty orange for orangutan, white hands for gibbon, bright natural red-blue muzzle for mandrill.
ROWS each repeat the SAME species, matching scale and identity in all six frames: row 1 broad muscular SILVERBACK GORILLA (no crown); row 2 lean black CHIMPANZEE with pale expressive face and big ears; row 3 shaggy russet ORANGUTAN with exceptionally long arms and broad cheek pads; row 4 slender cream GIBBON with very long thin arms, black face and white hands; row 5 olive MANDRILL on all fours with vivid red/blue long muzzle and tan mane; row 6 little CAPUCHIN with cream face, brown cap and long curled prehensile tail.
COLUMNS are distinctly different real animation key poses. Column 1 front-right 3/4 idle. Column 2 front-right 3/4 WALK with left arm and right leg reaching forward. Column 3 front-right 3/4 WALK opposite limb phase, right arm and left leg forward. Column 4 back-right 3/4 WALK with left arm and right leg forward. Column 5 back-right 3/4 WALK opposite limb phase. Column 6 front-right forceful ATTACK with one long arm raised or swung forward, low crouching followthrough. All 36 sprites have unique clearly articulated pose silhouettes. Size in cell stays consistent per species. Full tails and all limbs visible within cell. These are production reusable frames, crisp cutout edges and actual alpha transparency.
prompts.humans:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: finished production game sprite atlas PNG with actual transparent background.
Create 32 clearly separate full-body hand-painted soldier animation sprites, exactly 8 columns by 4 rows grid, equal 256x256 square cells, wide 2048x1024 image. No words, no labels, no scenery, no gridlines, no shadows on ground. Each entire figure and all equipment must fit within its cell with clear transparent margins; feet consistently on y=235 baseline; about 205px tall. Identical orthographic isometric camera 30 degrees above ground. Detailed dark cinematic 2D painted art with readable silhouette and believable cloth, helmets, boots, rifle metal, olive uniforms, slate armor, warm gray skin. Match serious ape survival strategy game.
ROW 1 ordinary patrol soldier: olive fatigues, soft field cap, small pistol, lightly equipped.
ROW 2 rifle infantry: olive helmet, armored vest, long rifle, backpack, military boots.
ROW 3 heavy armored guard: broad silhouette, dark slate ballistic helmet with visor, heavy armor, automatic machine gun, bulky ammunition pouches.
ROW 4 scout specialist: lighter forest green gear, hood/beret, precision long rifle, small radio backpack with antenna.
COLUMNS repeat same identity per row, all are actually different articulated key poses:
1 front-right three-quarter idle weapon lowered.
2 front-right WALK left leg forward, right leg back.
3 front-right WALK right leg forward, left leg back, arms counterpose.
4 front-right AIM shoulder weapon raised precisely.
5 front-right FIRE RECOIL, arms and torso visibly pulled back, no flash drawn.
6 back-right WALK left leg forward (back of uniform visible, face away).
7 back-right WALK right leg forward (back visible).
8 collapsed casualty on side, whole body horizontal low in cell, non-graphic no blood.
Every image a clean individual transparent cutout. Consistent equipment, anatomy, light from upper left in every cell.
